WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost, p.category AS cat_asof_sale
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned, p.category
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category, n.cat_asof_sale, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, MIN(d.calendar_date) mn, MAX(d.calendar_date) mx, COUNT(*) n_rows,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
       MIN(etl_loaded_at) mn_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) mx_load, MIN(sale_date) mn, MAX(sale_date) mx,
       SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost IS NULL OR standard_cost=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nocost
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-10'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT (sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, product_key)), NULL, NULL, MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date),
       SUM(CASE WHEN refund_net <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_returned IS NULL OR standard_cost_returned=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-10';

WITH dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-10'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 30;

WITH g AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT (product_key, quantity, net_amount, standard_cost, store_key, sale_ts_utc, COALESCE(member_key,-1))) variants,
         MIN(etl_loaded_at) first_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) last_load, MIN(sale_date) sd
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT c, variants, CAST(first_load AS DATE) fl, CAST(last_load AS DATE) ll, MIN(sd) min_sale, MAX(sd) max_sale, COUNT(*) n_groups
FROM g GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3,4;

SELECT s.store_id, w.status, w.web_order_id IS NULL AS no_order_row, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net,
       MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-10' AND DATE '2025-11-05'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT SUM(n.net_sales) AS total FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6
),
ctrl AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_sales) AS total, MIN(business_date) mn, MAX(business_date) mx, COUNT(*) n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6
)
SELECT mine.total AS mine, ctrl.total AS ctrl, mine.total-ctrl.total AS gap, ctrl.mn, ctrl.mx, ctrl.n FROM mine, ctrl;

SELECT cp.category,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sku) FROM dim_product WHERE is_current) AS dup_current_skus,
       COUNT(*) n_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity * p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost > f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_cost_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_qty,
       MIN(p.standard_unit_cost) mn_cost, MAX(p.standard_unit_cost) mx_cost
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02' AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY ALL;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT params.fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period, cp.category,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
  AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY cp.category;
